On fame and being remembered after death
</message>
output: It makes me wonder if anyone will even remember my name in a hundred years, and whether the things I do now will matter enough to leave a trace. I feel a quiet fear that my life will fade into nothingness, and a strange desire to leave something behind that feels real and lasting. At the same time, I realise that the pursuit of being remembered might be a distraction from the present moments that truly shape who I am.
